verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents a public API. The Checkout API is described as a flexible API that works for web and mobile from the same interface, there are POS machine APIs, and a developer API reference page includes Postman collections. A single-token CLI also operates payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports programmatically. Missing for 10: endpoint-level reference and authentication details beyond overview snippets, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Incorporate a flexible API into your website so that customers can shop on your website or app without being redirected to an external page.
Integrate into web or mobile apps using the same API.
Connect the POS machine APIs and manage payments in one place.
Postman is a tool that simplifies API development, testing, and documenting, allowing you to create and share requests quickly and securely.
With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
